subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` as a public channel capability and enable it by default for bundled Telegram final-mode TTS after the cancellation fallback bug is fixed?
rationale: The PR fixes a real bug, but it also expands the plugin-facing channel contract and changes an existing Telegram delivery default while a related issue asks for configurable separate text-plus-voice delivery.

options.title: Accept capability after repair
options.body: Fix the ACP cancellation gap, then merge this direction as the default Telegram fix and keep separate delivery as a distinct product issue.

options.title: Require delivery-mode design
options.body: Ask for a default-preserving option or policy shape before merge so existing users can choose captioned versus separate text and voice behavior.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR until maintainers settle the Telegram TTS delivery model.

recommendation.title: Accept capability after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the ACP cancellation gap, then merge this direction as the default Telegram fix and keep separate delivery as a distinct product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent channel capability and ACP/reply dispatch history make this the best available owner for the public capability and default behavior decision.
